title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Albay, in the Province of Albay, to Legaspi, and for Other Purposes

text.en:
The name of the municipality of Albay, capital of the province of the same name, is hereby
changed to Legaspi: Provided, "however, That all provincial and municipal government offices and their
dependencies shall continue in the former municipality of Albay.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1925.
